es: Explicar el contexto y la causa inmediata de un retraso.
Narrar la reacción mediante hechos ordenados y horas verificables.
Cerrar con una petición práctica y específica.

teaching.en: Nora: I was checking in for my flight when the fire alarm sounded. Staff moved everyone outside at 7:20. We returned thirty minutes later, but boarding had closed. I spoke to an agent and explained the delay. Could you book me on the 10:15 flight and keep my checked bag on the new booking? Agent: Yes, I can change both now.
teaching.es: Nora hacía el registro cuando sonó la alarma. El personal evacuó a todos a las 7:20. Volvieron treinta minutos después, pero el embarque había cerrado. Nora explicó el retraso y pidió al agente el vuelo de las 10:15 y conservar su equipaje; el agente aceptó.
teaching.explanationEs: El modelo integra contexto, interrupción, reacción, cronología y petición con respuesta.

prompt.es: Elige la explicación que incluye causa y petición práctica.

The bus broke down while I was travelling. Could I take the later tour?

feedback.es: La segunda opción explica la avería y solicita una alternativa concreta.

prompt.es: Explica el retraso de Kai y pide una solución.

answer.text: Kai was travelling to an interview when a signal problem stopped the train. He took a taxi. Could he arrive fifteen minutes late?
accepted: Kai was travelling to an interview when a signal problem stopped the train. He took a taxi. Could he arrive fifteen minutes late?
A signal failure stopped Kai's train while he was going to an interview. He took a taxi and asked to arrive fifteen minutes late.

feedback.es: Las variantes conservan trayecto, fallo, reacción y petición.

origin.text: Kai iba a entrevista. Tren se detuvo por problema de señal. Tomó taxi. Pide entrar 15 minutos tarde.

prompt.es: Redacta reacción y petición tras perder una conexión.

answer.text: Mina's flight arrived late, so she missed her connection and spoke to an agent. Could she take the 6:30 flight?
accepted: Mina's flight arrived late, so she missed her connection and spoke to an agent. Could she take the 6:30 flight?
Because Mina's flight was late, she missed the connection. She asked an agent for a seat on the 6:30 flight.

feedback.es: La respuesta conserva causa, reacción y alternativa horaria exacta.

origin.text: Vuelo llegó tarde; Mina perdió conexión. Habló con agente. Pide asiento en vuelo 18:30.

prompt.es: Escribe 70–100 palabras para explicar el retraso en la clínica.

answer.text: I was travelling by bus to a ten o'clock clinic appointment while traffic was moving slowly. At 9:25, an accident blocked the main avenue. I got off the bus at 9:40, walked for twenty minutes and called the clinic. The driver also gave me an incident number for the clinic. I will arrive at 10:20. Could you move my appointment to 10:30 and confirm that the doctor can still see me?
accepted: I was travelling by bus to a ten o'clock clinic appointment while traffic was moving slowly. At 9:25, an accident blocked the main avenue. I got off the bus at 9:40, walked for twenty minutes and called the clinic. The driver also gave me an incident number for the clinic. I will arrive at 10:20. Could you move my appointment to 10:30 and confirm that the doctor can still see me?

While I was taking the bus to my ten o'clock appointment, traffic was moving slowly. An accident blocked the avenue at 9:25. I left the bus at 9:40 and walked for twenty minutes before calling the clinic. The driver also gave me an incident number for the clinic. I expect to arrive at 10:20. Could I have the 10:30 appointment, and could you confirm it for me?

feedback.es: La explicación integra fondo, hora del bloqueo, reacción, llegada y petición verificable.

origin.text: Iba en autobús a cita 10:00. Tráfico lento. Accidente bloqueó avenida 9:25. Bajó 9:40, caminó 20 minutos, llamó clínica. Conductor dio número de incidente. Llegará 10:20. Pide mover cita a 10:30 y confirmar.

prompt.es: Escribe 70–100 palabras para explicar el retraso al curso.

answer.text: I was travelling by train to a two o'clock course, and the train was approaching the final station when a signal failed at 1:10. We waited for twenty-five minutes. The railway company sent a message confirming the signal problem. At 1:40, I took a taxi and contacted the instructor. I will arrive at 2:15. Could I join online until I arrive, and could you confirm the meeting link directly?
accepted: I was travelling by train to a two o'clock course, and the train was approaching the final station when a signal failed at 1:10. We waited for twenty-five minutes. The railway company sent a message confirming the signal problem. At 1:40, I took a taxi and contacted the instructor. I will arrive at 2:15. Could I join online until I arrive, and could you confirm the meeting link directly?

While I was going to a two o'clock training session, my train was nearing the last station. A signal failed at 1:10, so we waited twenty-five minutes. The railway company sent a message confirming the signal problem. I took a taxi at 1:40 and messaged the instructor. I expect to arrive at 2:15. Could you send the online link directly and let me join remotely until then?

feedback.es: La recuperación reconstruye cronología ferroviaria, alternativa y petición digital.

origin.text: Iba en tren a curso 14:00. Tren se acercaba a estación cuando señal falló 13:10. Esperó 25 minutos; empresa confirmó fallo por mensaje; tomó taxi 13:40; avisó instructor. Llegará 14:15. Pide unirse en línea y confirmar enlace.
